relationships.subject: endocrine-disrupting chemicals
relationships.evidence_quote: Mounting clinical, experimental, and epidemiologic evidence supports a significant link between exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals and the development and continuation of endometriosis

key_findings: EDCs (BPA, phthalates, dioxins, PCBs) are linked to endometriosis via xenoestrogenic action, immune dysregulation, oxidative stress, progesterone resistance and epigenetic reprogramming.
